about.lead: I build conversational and agentic systems that help people resolve blockers, complete controlled actions, and work safely with connected tools and data.
about.biographyMarkdown: My work combines voice interfaces, agentic automation, retrieval, product design, and human-in-the-loop controls. Relay applies those patterns to People Operations workflows. Refract connects RAG, interactive paper learning, battery analysis, and predictive-maintenance validation. My medical-imaging research uses computer vision and CNN ensembles with measured error analysis. Birb Hangout extends the same systems mindset into game design, interaction design, 3D annotation, and creative harness engineering.
about.currentFocusMarkdown:
## Working focus

- voice agents and conversational workflows with structured function calling
- agentic systems with authentication, confirmation, idempotency, and audit logs

- human-centered automation, rapid prototyping, game interaction, and creative tooling
